name: Acadlix Addon for Elementor
author: Team AcadLix

sections.description:
Acadlix Addon for Elementor extends the design capabilities of the Acadlix LMS by adding a collection of custom Elementor widgets specifically built for course pages.

Whether you’re using Elementor Free or Elementor Pro, this addon enables you to fully design:

  • Single Course Pages
  • All Courses
  • Dynamic course information sections
  • Interactive course features such as wishlist, curriculum, instructors, and more

Perfect for LMS websites, coaching platforms, educational institutes, or any WordPress site using Acadlix.

Widgets Included

This addon adds the following widgets to Elementor:

  • Course Title
  • Course Author
  • Course Breadcrumbs
  • Course Thumbnail
  • Course Difficulty Level
  • Course Duration
  • Course Students
  • Course Updated Date
  • Course Price
  • Course Wishlist
  • Course Instructors
  • Course Curriculum
  • Course Action Button
  • Course Description
  • Course Outcomes
  • Course Tags
  • Course Categories
  • Course List (For listing all courses dynamically)

Key Features

  • Full support for Elementor Free & Pro
  • Drag-and-drop widgets for course page design
  • Dynamic data fetched from Acadlix LMS
  • Customizable styling controls
  • Lightweight & optimized for performance
  • Works with any Elementor-compatible theme
  • No coding required

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.8 or higher
  • PHP 8.2 or higher
  • Acadlix LMS installed and active
  • Elementor plugin installed and active

How to Use

  1. Open Elementor editor for your Single Course Template or any page.
  2. Search for widgets under the “Acadlix” category.
  3. Drag widgets like Course Title, Price, Curriculum, Description, or Course List.
  4. Customize layout, typography, spacing, and styles.
  5. Publish your template.
  6. Go to Acadlix > Settings > General in your WordPress dashboard.
  7. Set your created template as the Single Course Template option.
  8. Save changes — Acadlix LMS will use your custom template for single course pages.

Developer Notes

  • Widgets built with Elementor’s latest API
  • Fully compatible with WordPress 6.8+
  • Follows Acadlix LMS data structure and template system
  • Supports custom hooks and filters for developers

Privacy Policy

Acadlix Addon for Elementor does not collect or send any user data externally. All data is processed within your WordPress installation.

Support

For support or feature requests, please visit:

  • Plugin Support Forum
  • Acadlix Website

Credits

Developed by the Acadlix Team, creators of the modern and developer-friendly Acadlix LMS.

Documentation

For full usage instructions, setup guides, and advanced tips, visit the official documentation:

Acadlix Addon for Elementor Documentation
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Acadlix Addon for Elementor”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Ensure Elementor and Acadlix LMS are active

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. All widgets work with Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Does this plugin work without Acadlix LMS?

No. Acadlix LMS must be installed and active for widgets to fetch course data.

Will the widgets work with my theme?

Yes. The addon works with any Elementor-compatible theme.

Can I design my Single Course and Course List pages completely?

Absolutely! You can replace default Acadlix layouts and build your own templates.
